title: My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy
notes:
Originally released under the label "Roc-A-Fella Records", since 2019 "UMG Recordings, Inc." is listed as the label.

Track #1 contains samples of "In High Places" by Mike Oldfield.
Track #2 contains portions of the composition "You Showed Me" Roger McGuinn & Gene Clark.
Track #3 contains elements from recording "It's Your Thing" by Cold Grits. It also contains material sampled from "21st Century Schizoid Man" by Crimson King.
Track #7 contains samples from the recording "You Are - I Am" by Manfred Mann.
Track #8 contains samples of the recording "Will You Still Love Me In The Morning" by Smokey Robinson.
Track #9 contains a sample of "Expo 83" by Backyard Heavies. It also contains samples of 'Live At Long Beach, CA, 1981' by Rick James.
Track #10 contains a sample of the recording "She's My Baby" by Mojo Men. It also contains samples of "Stud Spider" by Tony Joe White.
Track #11 contains elements of "Avril 14" by Richard James.
Track #12 contains portions of "Soul Makossa" written-by M. DiBango. It also contains a sample of the recording "Think (About It)" by Lyn Collins. It also contains samples of "The Woods" by Bon Iver. 
Track #13 contains samples of "Comment No. 1" by Gil-Scott Heron.
